say:2:1536128001:1.text: There's always a tryout before the Bloodhunt Festival. Only those who pass get to compete in the festival.
say:2:1536128001:1.source_cn: 每届猎血节之前都有一次选拔赛，只有通过的人才能参加猎血节。
say:2:1536128001:1.male: There's always a tryout before the Bloodhunt Festival. Only those who pass get to compete in the festival.
say:2:1536128001:1.female: There's always a tryout before the Bloodhunt Festival. Only those who pass get to compete in the festival.

say:3:1536128002:1.text: It's a lot tougher than the usual hunts. I was one of the best in the village, and still...
say:3:1536128002:1.source_cn: 选拔赛的竞争比平时激烈多啦，我在村里算是数一数二的战士...
say:3:1536128002:1.male: It's a lot tougher than the usual hunts. I was one of the best in the village, and still...
say:3:1536128002:1.female: It's a lot tougher than the usual hunts. I was one of the best in the village, and still...

say:4:1536128003:1.text: Got bested by someone from Mirehold!
say:4:1536128003:1.source_cn: 结果被水泽营地的人打败啦！
say:4:1536128003:1.male: Got bested by someone from Mirehold!
say:4:1536128003:1.female: Got bested by someone from Mirehold!
